# The Principles of the Doctrine of Christ

> Simple, Scripture-based Bible lessons for people who are new to faith in Jesus Christ, built on the six foundations named in Hebrews 6:1-2: repentance from dead works, faith toward God, the doctrine of baptisms, laying on of hands, resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment. Written by Dianna "Yv'e" Bridges. Scripture quotations are KJV; Greek word studies use Strong's Concordance.

## Lessons
- [What Is Repentance? Meaning of Metanoia (Greek G3341)](https://tpotdoc.com/repentance/): Repentance means changing your mind about sin and God, and letting it turn your life around. A simple word study of metanoia for new believers.
- [What Is Faith Toward God? Meaning of Pistis (Greek G4102)](https://tpotdoc.com/faith/): Faith means being persuaded that God is true and leaning your whole weight on Jesus. A simple word study of pistis, with Matthew 8 and 9.
- [Hebrew Roots of Baptism: Mikveh and Tevilah](https://tpotdoc.com/baptisms/): Baptism was not a Christian invention: Jews immersed in a mikveh to be made clean. John the Baptist's baptism, and what 'baptized for the dead' means.
- [What Is the Laying On of Hands? (Hebrews 6:2)](https://tpotdoc.com/laying-on-of-hands/): Laying on of hands is placing hands on someone in prayer to bless, heal, commission or receive the Holy Ghost. From Genesis 48 to Acts.
- [What Is the Resurrection of the Dead? Bible Verses](https://tpotdoc.com/resurrection/): God promises the dead will be raised bodily, as Jesus rose. Old Testament hope, people raised to life, and what Jesus and Paul taught.
- [What Is Eternal Judgment? What Jesus Taught](https://tpotdoc.com/eternal-judgment/): Eternal judgment is Jesus' final, forever verdict on every person. What He taught about the sheep and goats, hell, and escaping condemnation.
- [Neither Barren nor Unfruitful: 2 Peter 1:8 Word Study](https://tpotdoc.com/fruitful/): What 'barren' and 'unfruitful' mean in 2 Peter 1:8, and Peter's plan for growth: add to your faith virtue, knowledge, patience, godliness and love.

## Help for new believers
- [Scripture Prayers for Everyday Needs](https://tpotdoc.com/prayers/): Prayers from God's Word for everyday needs: before a test, when you are tested or tempted, and when you are afraid or anxious (2 Timothy 1:7).
- [Questions New Believers Ask](https://tpotdoc.com/questions/): Answers from God's Word to questions new Christians ask, like 'How do I know I really repented?'
- [Ask a Question or Request Prayer](https://tpotdoc.com/ask/): Send a question about the Christian faith or a prayer request. Every message is read personally and answered from God's Word.
- [Churches and 24/7 Prayer We Recommend](https://tpotdoc.com/churches/): Find a church that preaches the Word, pray 24/7 with the Billy Graham prayer line and BPN Radio, and play free Bible games for youth.
- [About Dianna "Yv'e" Bridges](https://tpotdoc.com/about/): Yv'e Bridges has taught God's Word in children's, youth, women's and singles ministries for decades, and wrote Praying A to Z.

## Bible games for youth (by Brandon Bridges; Scripture in the games is ESV)
- [Lamp Unto My Feet](https://tpotdoc.com/games/lamp-unto-my-feet/): A pilgrim with a lamp walks home through six of Jesus' parables, from the lost sheep to the empty tomb.
- [Armor of Light](https://tpotdoc.com/games/armor-of-light/): A Christian card game of pilgrimage. Build a deck from the armor of God, speak the Word, and stand firm through three illuminated books.
- [Watchmen on the Walls](https://tpotdoc.com/games/watchmen-on-the-walls/): Watchmen on the Walls: a tower defense game where you rebuild the walls of Jerusalem gate by gate with Nehemiah.
